units.source_text: 她们是互相诉说远赴他乡之苦。

en.t: They told one another of the hardships of having come so far to a strange land.

units.source_text: 经过了风波险恶的筑前金御崎海岬之后，她们想起了一曲古歌，

en.t: After passing the perilous, storm-tossed cape of Kanemisaki in Chikuzen, they remembered an old poem,

units.source_text: 便不断地吟唱：“我心终不忘”之句。

en.t: and kept chanting the line, "My heart shall never forget."

units.source_text: 不久到达了筑紫，进了太宰府。

en.t: Before long they reached Tsukushi and entered Dazaifu.

units.source_text: 现在离京更远，乳母等遥念在京失踪的夕颜，常常悲泣。

en.t: Now even farther from the capital, the nurse and the others often wept as they thought from afar of Yugao, who had vanished in the capital.

units.source_text: 只得悉心抚育玉鬘，聊以自慰。

en.t: They could only devote themselves to raising Tamakazura, taking what comfort they could from that.
The days passed one by one.

units.source_text: 乳母有时偶尔在梦中看见夕颜。

en.t: The nurse would sometimes see Yugao in her dreams.

units.source_text: 然而往往看见夕颜身旁有一个与她肖似的女子，而且梦醒之后常常心绪恶劣，身体患病。

en.t: Yet she often saw beside Yugao a woman who closely resembled her, and after waking from such dreams she would frequently feel distressed and fall ill.

units.source_text: 于是她想：“大约夫人已经不在人世了。”

en.t: Then she thought, "Perhaps my lady is no longer in this world."
From then on, her sorrow grew still deeper.
